selection.rule: Frozen 24 classification tasks, 8 OpenML-CTR23 regression tasks, 3 full public FEDOT series and 5 checksum-pinned FEDOT real-case series, selected before scores. Shared or unknown code evaluates the full set. Regression evaluation code also affects forecasting. Regression and five local series use relative deltas; the three existing public series retain absolute thresholds. The frozen categorical trait covers 8 classification and 3 regression datasets, but narrowing is allowed only for an isolated known one-hot helper with categorical-only callers and matching source spans; comments, strings, shared transforms, unknown callers and AST ambiguity cannot narrow the scope.
